# MockingMethodsCorrectness

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [PHPUnit](/rules/#phpunit) · PhpStorm name: `MockingMethodsCorrectnessInspection`

Two classes of PHPUnit mock-configuration mistakes inside tests:
passing a stub *object* (`$this->returnValue(...)`, `$this->returnCallback(...)`)
to `willReturn()` — which then returns the stub object itself instead of
running it — and configuring (`->method('name')`) a method that the mocked
class does not have, or that is `final` and therefore cannot be overridden by
the generated double.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{17,18,22,23,24,29} [Before]
<?php

class Ledger
{
    public function balance() {}
    final public function seal() {}
}

class LedgerTest
{
    public function testDoubles()
    {
        $stub = $this->getMockBuilder(Ledger::class)
            ->setMethods(['virtualTotal'])
            ->getMock();

        $stub->method('balance')->willReturn($this->returnValue(42));
        $stub->method('balance')->willReturn(self::returnCallback('strtoupper'));
        $stub->method('balance')->will($this->returnValue(42));
        $stub->method('balance')->willReturn(42);

        $stub->method('seal')->willReturn(true);
        $stub->method('refund')->willReturn(0);
        $stub->expects($this->once())->method("refund");
        $stub->method('virtualTotal')->willReturn(7);
        $stub->method('BALANCE')->willReturn(1);
        $stub->method($dynamic)->willReturn(1);

        $this->getMockBuilder(Ledger::class)->getMock()->method('seal');
        $this->createMock(Ledger::class)->method('refund');
    }
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php

class Ledger
{
    public function balance() {}
    final public function seal() {}
}

class LedgerTest
{
    public function testDoubles()
    {
        $stub = $this->getMockBuilder(Ledger::class)
            ->setMethods(['virtualTotal'])
            ->getMock();

        $stub->method('balance')->will($this->returnValue(42));
        $stub->method('balance')->will(self::returnCallback('strtoupper'));
        $stub->method('balance')->will($this->returnValue(42));
        $stub->method('balance')->willReturn(42);

        $stub->method('seal')->willReturn(true);
        $stub->method('refund')->willReturn(0);
        $stub->expects($this->once())->method("refund");
        $stub->method('virtualTotal')->willReturn(7);
        $stub->method('BALANCE')->willReturn(1);
        $stub->method($dynamic)->willReturn(1);

        $this->getMockBuilder(Ledger::class)->getMock()->method('seal');
        $this->createMock(Ledger::class)->method('refund');
    }
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 17: The stub object is returned as-is here; use &#39;-&gt;will(...)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 18: The stub object is returned as-is here; use &#39;-&gt;will(...)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 22: Final methods cannot be mocked.</li>
<li>line 23: The mocked class has no such method.</li>
<li>line 24: The mocked class has no such method.</li>
<li>line 29: Final methods cannot be mocked.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "MockingMethodsCorrectness": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore MockingMethodsCorrectness

/**
 * @noinspection MockingMethodsCorrectnessInspection
 */
```
